notes:
Here are three things a toddler could turn up to in Halton Hills this fall. Each comes from the venue's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent and Tot, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs, with parent participation, 30 min class",
      "when": "Fall 2026 session Sept 12 - Dec 18 (14 weeks); weekly class times are in their Fall 2026 schedule PDF. Registration opened July 20",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Parent and Tot swimming lessons (Parent and Tot 1/2/3), Acton Lion's Indoor Pool and Gellert Community Centre",
      "age_fit": "Parent and Tot 2: 12 to 24 months; Parent and Tot 3: 2 to 3 years old (Parent and Tot 1 is 4 to 12 months)",
      "when": "Fall: Acton Oct 3 - Dec 3, 2026; Gellert evenings and weekends Oct 3 - Dec 7, 2026. Non-residents can register from Tuesday, Sept 8",
      "price": "$86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson, Acton fall schedule)",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    },
    {
      "name": "Pre-school Drop In, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "Under 4 yrs (one of their pages says 4 and under); a parent stays with the child",
      "when": "Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30am - 12:00pm, school year only. Their pages disagree on the start date (Sept 15 on one, Oct 9 on another)",
      "price": "$15 for one parent and up to 4 children; no pre-registration, first come",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Gymnastics Centre class price:** I did not find a price for Parent and Tot on the pages I read, so I left it out.
- **Gymnastics Centre class times:** The weekly times are in a PDF table. I couldn't tie the columns to specific days reliably, so I gave the session dates and not a day and time.
- **Drop-in dates:** The drop-in pages disagree on the start date, and one still shows 2026 dates from the previous school year. It is worth confirming with them before going.
- **Swim lesson price:** The $86.22 is the Acton fall price. I did not tie a price to the Gellert schedule.
